description: The file contains the implementation of the ActivationRepartitioner class, which manages message processing and edge handling for Orleans grain activation repartitioning, including starting/stopping processing, recording messages, and processing pending edges.

classes.name: ActivationRepartitioner
classes.description: Handles message statistics and grain activation repartitioning, manages processing tasks, filters, and message recording for migration.

methods.name: StartProcessingEdges
methods.description: Starts the process that handles pending message edges asynchronously.

methods.name: StopProcessingEdgesAsync
methods.description: Stops the message processing task, waits for completion, and performs cleanup.

methods.name: ProcessPendingEdges
methods.description: Processes queued messages, filters and converts them into edges, and manages yield behavior for fairness.

methods.name: GetMessageObserver
methods.description: Provides an observer action to record incoming messages for analysis.

methods.name: RecordMessage
methods.description: Records relevant messages, filtering out system or response messages and signals the pending message event.
